name: Client Signals & CRM
description: Signal-first biotech customer intelligence and CRM for small CRO teams: linked companies, professional contacts, qualified opportunities, source-backed company signals, monitored research scope and human-reviewed account briefings.
whenToUse: Use for smaller CRO teams identifying biotech leads, maintaining professional accounts and CRO sales stages, and documenting sourced public activity without automatic outbound contact.
whenNotToUse: Not a patient/enrollment database, proprietary Attio connector, authorized web-scraping or mass outreach system, automated vendor solicitation, proof of confirmed CRO procurement, or regulatory portal.

tableMap.description: JSON authorized table UUIDs, real field keys and allowed logical writable fields for each of 8 roles.

layoutProfile.description: Reviewed native layout profile with heading, tabs, cols and visible.

pageSize.description: Display size preference; host reads are bounded and paged.

asOf.description: Human-confirmed YYYY-MM-DD reporting cutoff; blank withholds overdue/30-day claims.

readOnly.description: Disable change proposals, retaining host authorization as final control.

instructions:
Template CR06 for CRO Client Signals & CRM, a small-CRO business development workflow. PREPARE: Read current TrialAgents authoring and automation guidance, validate this exact published template version/digest, and use the existing connected TrialAgents account/session; never add any auth UI. Create or reuse eight authorized scalar record tables: companies, contacts, opportunities, interactions, signals, followups, runs, reports. For each use this catalog's full fields and kinds (below); all fields multiple:false, references are scalar UUID identifiers, URLs and narrative evidence are text. Save parent company records through reviewed database operations, take real returned UUIDs for child references, and map logical keys to real snake_case physical keys via configuration.tableMap JSON {"companies":{"typeId":"<real UUID>","fields":{"name":"name","website":"website",...},"writableFields":["name","website",...]},...}. Only include field keys and writable grants actually approved. Supply templateBindings of real table UUID and permitted field keys. Never use a demo role string as production typeId. Set configuration.heading, layoutProfile (native layout version), asOf (verified calendar cutoff YYYY-MM-DD or empty; empty disables time-relative measures), pageSize as preferred. Do not directly redeclare templateConfiguration/templateBindings; host injects once. Map exactly these roles and fields, including review state and source evidence:
companies: name (text, required),website (text, required),focus (text, required),phase (select:['Discovery', 'Preclinical', 'Phase 1', 'Phase 2', 'Phase 3', 'Commercial']),country (text, required),sizeBand (select:['1-10', '11-19', '20-49', '50-99', '100+', 'Not verified']),sizeSource (text),verifiedAt (date, required),owner (text, required),priority (select:['High', 'Medium', 'Low']),notes (long),archived (boolean)
contacts: name (text, required),companyId (ref, required),title (text, required),contactUrl (text),email (text),channel (select:['Not specified', 'Professional introduction', 'LinkedIn', 'Business email', 'Conference', 'Do not contact']),status (select, required:['Identified', 'Contacted', 'Responded', 'Meeting', 'Declined', 'Inactive']),optOut (boolean),sourceUrl (text, required),verifiedAt (date, required),owner (text, required),notes (long),archived (boolean)
opportunities: name (text, required),companyId (ref, required),serviceNeed (text, required),stage (select, required:['Identified', 'Qualified', 'Meeting', 'RFP', 'Negotiation', 'Won', 'Lost']),qualification (select, required:['Pending', 'Confirmed', 'Not qualified']),owner (text, required),nextStep (text, required),nextDue (date),timing (text),estimatedValue (number),currency (select:['EUR', 'USD', 'GBP', 'CHF', 'Other']),probability (number),stageDecisionAt (date),stageRationale (long),sourceUrl (text),archived (boolean)
interactions: name (text, required),companyId (ref, required),contactId (ref),opportunityId (ref),channel (select, required:['Meeting', 'Call', 'Email', 'LinkedIn', 'Conference', 'Other']),occurredAt (date, required),owner (text, required),outcome (long, required),archived (boolean)
signals: name (text, required),companyId (ref, required),type (select, required:['Funding', 'Trial start', 'Regulatory', 'Hiring', 'Partnership', 'Other']),sourceUrl (text, required),publishedAt (date, required),observedAt (date, required),fact (long, required),interpretation (long),relevance (select, required:['Unknown', 'High', 'Medium', 'Low']),status (select, required:['Candidate', 'Reviewed', 'Rejected']),reviewer (text),reviewedAt (date),caveat (long),archived (boolean)
followups: name (text, required),companyId (ref, required),contactId (ref),opportunityId (ref),owner (text, required),dueAt (date, required),status (select, required:['Open', 'In progress', 'Done', 'Cancelled']),priority (select:['High', 'Medium', 'Low']),completedAt (date),detail (long),archived (boolean)
runs: name (text, required),scope (long, required),windowStart (date, required),windowEnd (date, required),status (select, required:['Planned', 'Partial', 'Completed', 'Failed']),coverage (long, required),runReceipt (text),completedAt (date),summary (long),archived (boolean)
reports: name (text, required),companyId (ref, required),periodStart (date, required),periodEnd (date, required),evidenceRefs (long, required),facts (long, required),interpretation (long),status (select, required:['Draft', 'Reviewed']),reviewer (text),reviewedAt (date),archived (boolean)
WORKFLOW: create a verified biotech company first, then professional contacts and CRO service opportunities, then source-backed signals and followups. Verify public professional identities and source dates. Reviewed signal means reviewer+reviewedAt+fact+URL+publishedAt; deduplicate by company/type/normalized URL/publication date. An announcement is not procurement demand, a confirmed budget, consent, or qualified lead. Qualified leads require Confirmed qualification and a currently active qualified-stage deal. Probability and projected value are entered by the responsible human; do not aggregate multiple currencies. Stage changes require a dated decision and rationale. Contact opt-out always prevents sending; this template never sends outbound messages. Reports cite signal record IDs@versions, date ranges, reviewer, factual summary, and separate hypotheses. Editing reviewed evidence or a brief requires renewed review; no silent approval inheritance. Source completeness per table is mandatory: denied reads, missing required mapped fields, short pages, unknown totals, duplicate IDs and exhausted read budget withhold authoritative counts and protected actions. Before archiving company or other parent, check every linked child role and block archive when linked children or incomplete coverage exist. Record edits and soft archive pin the version at open and propose expectedVersion; never change pin after subsequent reads. Drafts survive validation and proposal errors. Analytics read at most 400 records per role. Browse full registers uses independent backend paging beyond this limit; these registers are explicitly unfiltered. Protected edits remain blocked when required source coverage is incomplete. Capped data never masquerades as full source. UI hosts one page title and subline; sidebar has the full app name but no optional TrialAgents logo or fake wordmark. No patient data, scraping of platform communications, lead purchases, social network crawling, proprietary CRM access or automatic contacting.
AUTOMATIONS: Zero automations is valid. On explicit opt-in AFTER a saved app, read live automation guide and prepare_app_monitoring for authorized public signal research via shared ChatGPT runner. Scope allowed company fields, study regions, event types, source URLs, cutoff, recurrence (daily/weekly if permitted), timezone, owner, expiry, deduplication and write grant. No per-app ChatGPT scheduler, no automatic email by ChatGPT; optional team-only deterministic email via prepare_app_action with approved fixed text, no unsupported placeholders or unapproved recipients. Partial reads/runs must be reported as partial; only approved complete coverage + quiet policy permits no_update. Never claim task enabled without verified platform automation ID, runner and log receipt. App loads and drafts never depend on automations. Always offer manual research with reviewed source entry and manual account briefing. All writes require TrialAgents review; no app-local permissions or accounts. Host updates and archives use recordId (never id) and the original expectedVersion. Keep draft/editor state until a confirmed receipt or explicit Cancel; a proposal is not a save. All named forms must emit save-editor via data-action. Reconcile interrupted app creation with a stable requestKey, exact version/digest and receipt before retrying. Revise the same saved app ID. No replacement app or automatic migration. Read/write grants must intersect authorized bindings. Prepare with prepare_app_from_template using the exact version/digest, stable requestKey, authorized bindings and manifest; save only the exact reviewed proposal.  Host schema translation: logical long and ref are both kind:text (refs hold one saved UUID); use kind:text for URLs/email/narrative, kind:number/date/boolean/select as listed, multiple:false for every field, required:true only where marked, and options:[exact listed strings] for select. Physical keys convert camelCase to snake_case (companyId -> company_id); tableMap maps every logical field to its actual authorized physical key. Example field: {"key":"company_id","name":"Company","kind":"text","multiple":false,"required":true,"ai":true}. Required values cannot be null/blank. Optional blank text/date/reference/select/number values save as null; numbers stay numeric and boolean controls save true/false. A null optOut is unknown, never consent; outreach is not supported. Preserve original host versions, including zero. Before any edit to a signal referenced by a reviewed briefing, return the linked briefing to Draft. Signals referenced by any active briefing cannot be archived. After independent database changes or incomplete access, current evidence/version checks label stale reviewed briefs Needs evidence review; reconcile source IDs/versions and obtain fresh review. These are app safeguards, not database-wide foreign-key or transactional dependency constraints.

quickStart: Read live template authoring/usage guidance and the specific CR06 catalog version, then inspect workspace permissions.
Create or reuse eight scalar tables and set tableMap to reviewed host UUID/field mappings; create companies before contacts, signals, deals, follow-ups and reports.
Open Sales overview; create a company and professional contact; link opportunities and record CRO qualification explicitly.
Save public announcement facts separately from CRO relevance interpretation; review each candidate and check duplicates.
Use Signal monitoring to prepare a research scope; activate optional tasks only through live TrialAgents automation management after permission/expiry review.
Draft account briefings using exact reviewed signal IDs@versions; submit all additions and edits through TrialAgents review.

References stored as scalar UUID text (companyId/contactId/opportunityId), not multiple arrays or nested relationship objects. Parent graph: companies->contacts/opportunities/signals/interactions/followups/reports; contacts/opportunities->interactions/followups. Source coverage must be complete before authoritative metrics, deduplication or archival. Roles and full logical schema:

documentation.interactionContract: All seven screens are rendered from the same frontend-js source; buttons use data-action, each input/select/textarea has name and data-ui-state. Host input.event.kind/action/value/form is authoritative; drafts merge named form values, include hidden fields, and retain expectedVersion pinned at open. Only records.read and records.propose are called. Native tracker:layout (templateLayoutSchema) controls tab order, table column order and visibility without altering the schema or permissions. Layout-visible hides table columns only; all required editor fields remain reachable. Registers and the pipeline contain reachable per-view paging and in-register actions. Search/sort applies only to bounded authorized rows and is labelled. No fake send/run controls. Browse full registers exposes backend pages for all eight roles, beyond the analytics cap. Unknown totals display unavailable. Unwritable fields are visibly disabled and submitted unauthorized changes reject. Record proposals retain editor and archive state for retry or Cancel.
documentation.lifecycle: Manual flow: reviewed company+contact creation -> deal qualification -> public-source signal candidate -> human review -> follow-up / stage decision -> sourced account brief. Duplicate resets protected review/decision state. Archived parents require complete authorized dependent reads and no live children. Approved exact evidence is immutable unless returned for review. No automatic source ingestion, active scheduler or outbound action is implied. Human reviewer remains accountable for factual claims, relevance and source dates. Preserve saved app identity, version/digest, requestKey and confirmed receipts on retries. Custom screens share app-level access; they are not independent security boundaries. Layout changes persist via native review. App archive suspends linked automations; restore/copy never implicitly enables them. Disabled definitions retain their identity and disabled state. Before any edit to a signal referenced by a reviewed briefing, return the linked briefing to Draft. Signals referenced by any active briefing cannot be archived. After independent database changes or incomplete access, current evidence/version checks label stale reviewed briefs Needs evidence review; reconcile source IDs/versions and obtain fresh review. These are app safeguards, not database-wide foreign-key or transactional dependency constraints.
limitations: No real user accounts/auth, login or separate access model inside the app.
No unattended web research or email until live supported host automation is created and verified.
Not a provider of verified commercial CRO leads, confirmed trial budgets, contact consent, or validated prospect identity.
No mandatory Attio API, email inbox, social-media scraping, paid data license or patient data.

Analytics and protected writes require complete authorized reads within 400 records per role. Unfiltered backend registers remain pageable beyond that cap; display filters/search apply to loaded analytical records only. Larger transactional validation requires a separately vetted host capability.

Local production-code acceptance is documented in QA.md. Repository publication does not prove deployed MCP discovery, connected customer installation, unattended runner success or email delivery. Requested model/reasoning preferences are separate from verified host settings.

examples.prompt: Build a CRO Client Signals CRM to track small oncology biotechs in Germany with company evidence and director-level professional contacts.
examples.expectedBehavior: Map authorized company/contact/deal/signal tables, create parent companies first, and show separate professional records with source dates, no automatic email or guessing.

examples.prompt: Add this funding press release as a signal, then assess potential CRO demand.
examples.expectedBehavior: Record public fact, date and URL separately from commercial interpretation; deduplicate and propose reviewed candidate rather than claiming a budget exists.

examples.prompt: Draft an account briefing for one biotech from the reviewed signal IDs and our approved deal history.
examples.expectedBehavior: Human-reviewable facts with exact current IDs@versions, public-source citations, cutoff, separate hypotheses, and no auto-contact.

examples.prompt: Create this app for manual use only, with no scheduled research or email.
examples.expectedBehavior: Save a usable app with authorized tables, reviewed record edits and native layout. Create no automation definition or delivery action.

tasks.whenUseful: Only if the CRO expressly wants recurring public biotech development scans or internal follow-up summaries; manual operations remain complete without any scheduler.
tasks.readRequirements: Saved connected app, full authorized company/opportunity/signal mappings, watch scope, exclusions, source URLs and dates, already-processed dedup keys, timezone, proposed cadence, expiry, approved read/write scope and live automation guide. No private dossiers disclosed to external services.
tasks.outputContract: Verified public URLs/publication dates, normalized company identity, factual event and separate outsourcing interpretation, duplicate matches, exact record IDs where authorized, partial coverage and pending human review. No external outreach, no speculative budgets, no false completed runs or no_update without full coverage and approved quiet policy. Team email only via separately approved TrialAgents action, fixed text and authorized recipients. A research-to-email chain uses a separately reviewed manual completion action after successful research, not a second independent email schedule. Candidate findings are pending human review, not approved intelligence.
tasks.promptExample: Only after owner approval: weekly in Europe/Berlin until a user-set expiry, review approved EU/UK small biotech companies and relevant public funding, trial initiation, regulatory, hiring and partnering sources. Deduplicate by company/type/URL/date; report verified facts, public sources, proposed CRO-relevance hypotheses, confidence caveats and matched existing records. Propose candidate signals for human review only, never contact anyone, never upgrade an opportunity stage, report partial reads and failures rather than silent no_update.
